parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description:
The bandwidth. Unit: Kbps.

> This parameter is not available.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the replication pair-consistent group. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: EnableRtc
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable replication time control (RTC). Valid values:

- false: RTC is disabled.

- true: RTC is enabled.

> If this parameter is set to true, RTC is enabled for the replication pair-consistent group. RTC is also enabled for all asynchronous replication pairs that are added to the group.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the replication pair-consistent group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: RPO
parameters.description: The recovery point objective (RPO) of the replication pair-consistent group. Unit: seconds. A value of 900 is supported.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the replication pair-consistent group.

parameters.name: ReplicaGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the replication pair-consistent group. Call [DescribeDiskReplicaGroups](~~426614~~) to query the IDs of replication pair-consistent groups.
